senses.en: a device for fastening sheets of paper with staples

example.en: Could you pass me the stapler?
example.zh: 把订书机递给我好吗？

senses.en: becoming gradually narrower or smaller toward one end

example.en: The tower has an elegant tapering shape.
example.zh: 这座塔呈优雅的渐细形状。

senses.en: the act of gradually reducing an amount or dose

example.en: The doctor recommended a gradual tapering of the medication.
example.zh: 医生建议逐渐减少用药量。

senses.en: unwilling to accept new ideas or change old ways of doing things
senses.zh: 思想顽固的；墨守成规的

example.en: The committee was too hidebound to consider the proposal.
example.zh: 委员会太墨守成规，不愿考虑这项提议。

senses.en: an official publication of notices, or a newspaper

example.en: The new regulations were published in the official gazette.
example.zh: 新规定刊登在官方公报上。

senses.en: to announce something in an official gazette

example.en: The appointment was gazetted last week.
example.zh: 这项任命于上周在公报上公布了。

senses.en: things that people do, especially for enjoyment, education, or work

example.en: The camp offers many outdoor activities for children.
example.zh: 这个夏令营为孩子们提供许多户外活动。

senses.en: movement or busy action

example.en: There was a lot of activity in the market this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午市场活动频繁。

senses.en: to breathe air, gas, or smoke into the lungs

example.en: Take a deep breath and inhale slowly.
example.zh: 深吸一口气，慢慢吸气。

senses.en: an extra benefit that comes with a job, in addition to salary

example.en: A company car is one of the perks of the job.
example.zh: 公司配车是这份工作的福利之一。

senses.en: to become more cheerful or lively, or to make something do so

example.en: The dog perked up when it heard its name.
example.zh: 狗听到自己的名字时精神了起来。

senses.en: a principle or belief held to be true, especially by a group or religion

example.en: Freedom of speech is a central tenet of democracy.
example.zh: 言论自由是民主的核心信条。

senses.en: a liquid applied to the skin for cleaning, soothing, or moisturizing

example.en: She applies lotion to her hands after washing them.
example.zh: 她洗完手后会涂护手液。

senses.en: a short stop in an activity before it continues

example.en: There was a brief pause before the meeting continued.
example.zh: 会议继续前有短暂的停顿。

senses.en: to stop an activity for a short time before continuing

example.en: She paused at the door to check her phone.
example.zh: 她在门口停下来查看手机。

senses.en: extremely good or impressive

example.en: She gave a brilliant performance in the final.
example.zh: 她在决赛中表现得非常出色。

senses.en: very bright or vivid

example.en: The sky was brilliant with stars.
example.zh: 天空繁星闪烁，十分明亮。

senses.en: exceptionally intelligent or talented

example.en: He is a brilliant scientist.
example.zh: 他是一位才华横溢的科学家。

senses.en: to hold someone tightly in your arms to show affection

example.en: She hugged her friend goodbye at the airport.
example.zh: 她在机场拥抱朋友道别。

senses.en: an act of holding someone tightly in your arms with affection

example.en: A hug from my mother always makes me feel better.
example.zh: 妈妈的拥抱总能让我心情好起来。

senses.en: to fit closely or cling tightly to something

example.en: The road hugs the coastline for several miles.
example.zh: 这条路沿着海岸线蜿蜒数英里。

senses.en: a small pouch sewn inside or on a garment for carrying small things

example.en: He put the receipt in his coat pocket.
example.zh: 他把收据放进了外套口袋里。

senses.en: small enough to carry in a pocket

example.en: She bought a pocket dictionary for the trip.
example.zh: 她为这次旅行买了一本袖珍词典。

senses.en: to put something into your pocket

example.en: He pocketed the keys and left.
example.zh: 他把钥匙装进口袋就离开了。

senses.en: A written or printed symbol used to show or identify something.

example.en: Put a mark next to the correct answer.
example.zh: 在正确答案旁边做个记号。

senses.en: To write or draw a symbol on something to identify it or show a fact.

example.en: She marked the box with a red cross.
example.zh: 她用红色十字标记了那个箱子。

senses.en: A score or grade for schoolwork, especially in British English.
senses.zh: 分数；成绩（尤用于英式英语）

example.en: She got full marks on the spelling test.
example.zh: 她在拼写测验中得了满分。

senses.en: almost not

example.en: I can hardly hear you.
example.zh: 我几乎听不见你说话。

senses.en: only just; scarcely

example.en: We had hardly started when it began to rain.
example.zh: 我们刚开始就下雨了。

senses.en: a game in which players hit a small ball into holes on a large outdoor course using as few strokes as possible

example.en: She plays golf every weekend.
example.zh: 她每个周末都打高尔夫球。

senses.en: to play golf

example.en: They golfed together on Saturday.
example.zh: 他们周六一起打高尔夫球。

senses.en: the amount of space that an object or container occupies or can hold

example.en: The volume of the tank is measured in liters.
example.zh: 这个水箱的体积以升计量。

senses.en: the amount or quantity of something

example.en: The store tracks sales volume every month.
example.zh: 这家商店每月跟踪销售量。

senses.en: the level of sound produced by a device or speaker

example.en: Please turn down the volume on the television.
example.zh: 请把电视的音量调低。

senses.en: The act or process of making something better.

example.en: The new training program led to a clear improvement in staff performance.
example.zh: 新的培训项目使员工绩效明显改善。

senses.en: A change or addition that makes something better.

example.en: The software update includes several improvements to the user interface.
example.zh: 这次软件更新包含了对用户界面的几项改进。

senses.en: not able to exist or work together

example.en: Their schedules are incompatible, so they rarely meet.
example.zh: 他们的时间安排不相容，所以很少见面。

senses.en: not able to be used together, such as software or equipment

example.en: This old printer is incompatible with my new computer.
example.zh: 这台旧打印机与我的新电脑不兼容。

senses.en: a small slow-moving creature with a soft body and a spiral shell

example.en: A snail slowly crawled across the garden path.
example.zh: 一只蜗牛慢慢地爬过花园的小路。

senses.en: an edible snail served as food, often cooked with butter and garlic

example.en: She ordered snails with garlic butter at the French restaurant.
example.zh: 她在那家法国餐厅点了蒜蓉黄油蜗牛。

senses.en: to protect something from heat, cold, electricity, or noise by covering it with special material

example.en: The pipes are insulated to prevent heat loss in winter.
example.zh: 管道做了隔热处理，以防止冬季热量流失。

senses.en: to protect someone from unpleasant experiences or bad influences
senses.zh: 使隔绝；使免受（不良影响）

example.en: Parents cannot insulate their children from every difficulty.
example.zh: 父母无法使孩子免受一切困难。

senses.en: to become faster or make something faster

example.en: Her pulse quickened when she heard the news.
example.zh: 听到这个消息时，她的脉搏加快了。

senses.en: to stimulate or give life and energy to something

example.en: The debate quickened interest in the issue.
example.zh: 这场辩论激发了对该问题的兴趣。

senses.en: to tend to do or believe something; to have a natural tendency

example.en: I incline to accept his explanation.
example.zh: 我倾向于接受他的解释。

senses.en: to lean or slope in a particular direction; to bend (often used reflexively)

example.en: She inclined her head to listen more closely.
example.zh: 她侧着头想听得更清楚。

senses.en: a slope or slanted surface

example.en: The truck slowed down on the steep incline.
example.zh: 卡车在陡坡上放慢了速度。

senses.en: polluted air that forms a visible haze, often from smoke or chemical reactions involving exhaust gases
senses.zh: 烟雾；雾霾（空气污染形成的混浊薄雾）

example.en: The city was covered in thick smog for days.
example.zh: 这座城市连续多天被浓重的雾霾笼罩。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Jonathan is coming to the party tonight.
example.zh: 乔纳森今晚要来参加聚会。

senses.en: a red late-ripening apple, mainly eaten raw
senses.zh: 乔纳森苹果（一种晚熟的红色苹果，多生食）

example.en: She bought a basket of Jonathans at the market.
example.zh: 她在市场上买了一篮乔纳森苹果。

senses.en: nearby or next to something; bordering or adjacent

example.en: We often shop in the neighboring town.
example.zh: 我们常在邻近的镇上购物。

senses.en: again and again; repeatedly over a period of time

example.en: He continually interrupts me when I speak.
example.zh: 我说话时他不断地打断我。

senses.en: not yet decided or settled

example.en: The court case is still pending.
example.zh: 法庭案件仍未判决。

senses.en: while waiting for something to happen

example.en: He remains in office pending the results of the inquiry.
example.zh: 在调查结果出来之前，他继续留任。

senses.en: a large gland behind the stomach that produces digestive juices and insulin

example.en: The pancreas helps regulate blood sugar levels.
example.zh: 胰腺有助于调节血糖水平。

senses.en: a cancerous tumour or the quality of being dangerous and likely to spread (medicine)

example.en: The biopsy showed no sign of malignancy.
example.zh: 活组织检查未显示恶性迹象。

senses.en: strong ill will or evil intent

example.en: There was real malignancy in his tone.
example.zh: 他的语气里带着真正的恶毒。

senses.en: impossible to change or cancel
senses.zh: 不可撤销的；不可更改的

example.en: She made an irrevocable decision to move abroad.
example.zh: 她做出了移居国外的不可更改的决定。

senses.en: to organize people or resources for action, especially for war

example.en: The government mobilised thousands of troops within days.
example.zh: 政府在几天内动员了数千名士兵。

senses.en: low land between hills or mountains, often with a river

example.en: A small village sits in the valley.
example.zh: 一个小村庄坐落在山谷中。

senses.en: a low point in a changing situation

example.en: Every career has peaks and valleys.
example.zh: 每个职业生涯都有高峰和低谷。

senses.en: the condition of your body or mind

example.en: Her health improved after she started swimming.
example.zh: 她开始游泳后健康状况好转了。

senses.en: the state of being well and not ill

example.en: He is in good health for his age.
example.zh: 以他的年龄来说，他身体很健康。

senses.en: medical care and services provided for people

example.en: The government increased spending on health.
example.zh: 政府增加了医疗卫生支出。

senses.en: used to join words or phrases that are added together
senses.zh: 用于连接词或短语，表示并列或添加

example.en: She bought bread and milk.
example.zh: 她买了面包和牛奶。

senses.en: used to join clauses, often showing sequence or result
senses.zh: 用于连接分句，常表示先后或结果

example.en: He opened the door and went inside.
example.zh: 他打开门走了进去。

senses.en: used between numbers when saying them, especially after hundreds or thousands
senses.zh: 用于数字之间，尤在百位或千位后

example.en: There are two hundred and thirty students.
example.zh: 有两百三十名学生。

senses.en: the season between winter and summer, when plants begin to grow

example.en: The garden is full of flowers in spring.
example.zh: 春天花园里开满了花。

senses.en: a coiled piece of metal that returns to its shape after being pressed

example.en: The old chair has a broken spring.
example.zh: 那把旧椅子有一根坏了的弹簧。

senses.en: to move or jump suddenly and quickly

example.en: The cat sprang onto the table.
example.zh: 猫跳到了桌子上。

senses.en: a place where water comes up naturally from the ground

example.en: We drank cold water from a mountain spring.
example.zh: 我们喝了山泉里的凉水。

senses.en: a soft, low, continuous sound
senses.zh: 低语声；低沉连续的声音

example.en: She could hear the murmur of voices from the next room.
example.zh: 她能听到隔壁房间里传来的低语声。

senses.en: an abnormal soft sound made by the heart or blood flow

example.en: The doctor detected a heart murmur during the check-up.
example.zh: 医生在检查时发现了心脏杂音。

senses.en: to say something in a soft, quiet voice

example.en: 'Good night,' he murmured as he closed the door.
example.zh: '晚安，'他关门时低声说道。

senses.en: to complain quietly or privately

example.en: The staff murmured about the new schedule.
example.zh: 员工们对新安排低声抱怨。

senses.en: having little or no hair on the head

example.en: My uncle went bald in his thirties.
example.zh: 我叔叔三十多岁时就秃了。

senses.en: without any extra decoration, detail, or effort to soften the truth
senses.zh: 光秃的；直白的，不加掩饰的

example.en: He gave a bald statement of the facts.
example.zh: 他直截了当地陈述了事实。

senses.en: inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, or skilled

example.en: She is a formidable opponent in chess.
example.zh: 她是国际象棋中一位强大的对手。

senses.en: very difficult to deal with or overcome

example.en: They faced a formidable challenge in rebuilding the company.
example.zh: 他们在重建公司时面临一项艰巨的挑战。

senses.en: impressively large in size or amount

example.en: The repairs cost a formidable amount of money.
example.zh: 修理花了一大笔钱。

senses.en: intended to look attractive rather than to be useful

example.en: The pillows on the sofa are purely decorative.
example.zh: 沙发上的抱枕纯属装饰用。

senses.en: a written statement showing how much money you owe for goods or services

example.en: The waiter brought us the bill after dinner.
example.zh: 晚餐后服务员给我们送来了账单。

senses.en: a proposed law that is discussed in a legislature before being voted on

example.en: Parliament is debating a new bill on housing.
example.zh: 议会正在讨论一项关于住房的新法案。

senses.en: a banknote; a piece of paper money (mainly US)

example.en: He paid with a ten-dollar bill.
example.zh: 他用一张十美元的钞票付款。

senses.en: to send someone a statement of money owed; to charge for a service

example.en: The hotel bills guests for extra services.
example.zh: 酒店就额外服务向客人收费。

senses.en: a flying insect that makes honey and can sting

example.en: A bee flew into the garden and landed on a flower.
example.zh: 一只蜜蜂飞进花园，落在花朵上。

senses.en: a gathering where people work together or compete in a task
senses.zh: 集体活动；劳动聚会（如拼字比赛、缝纫聚会）

example.en: She won the school spelling bee last year.
example.zh: 她去年赢了学校的拼字比赛。

senses.en: a quick or brief look at something

example.en: I caught a glimpse of the sunset before the train entered the tunnel.
example.zh: 火车进入隧道前，我匆匆看了一眼日落。

senses.en: a brief or incomplete view or understanding of something
senses.zh: 初步的了解；短暂的体验

example.en: The documentary gives a glimpse into life in the Arctic.
example.zh: 这部纪录片让人初步了解北极的生活。

senses.en: to see something briefly or incompletely

example.en: She glimpsed her old friend through the crowd.
example.zh: 她透过人群瞥见了老朋友。

senses.en: an organ in the body that produces and releases substances such as hormones

example.en: Sweat glands help control body temperature.
example.zh: 汗腺帮助调节体温。

senses.en: the capital of the Australian state of Victoria and the country's second-largest city

example.en: Melbourne is famous for its coffee and street art.
example.zh: 墨尔本以咖啡和街头艺术闻名。

senses.en: a city in east central Florida, US
senses.zh: 墨尔本（美国佛罗里达州城市）

example.en: They flew into Melbourne, Florida, for the conference.
example.zh: 他们飞抵佛罗里达州的墨尔本参加会议。

senses.en: the act of deliberately destroying a building or structure

example.en: The demolition of the old factory took two weeks.
example.zh: 旧工厂的拆除花了两个星期。

senses.en: the highest range of sound or voice, especially in music; also the high-pitched part of a recording

example.en: Turn down the treble; the music sounds too sharp.
example.zh: 把高音调低些，音乐听起来太刺耳了。

senses.en: three times as great or as many

example.en: The company reported treble profits this year.
example.zh: 公司今年公布的利润是原来的三倍。

senses.en: to increase or make something three times as much

example.en: House prices trebled in a decade.
example.zh: 房价在十年间涨至三倍。

senses.en: a person who helps someone commit a crime

example.en: The police arrested a man suspected of being an accomplice.
example.zh: 警方逮捕了一名涉嫌充当同谋的男子。

senses.en: a list of books or sources used in a work

example.en: Remember to include a bibliography at the end of your paper.
example.zh: 记得在论文末尾附上参考书目。

senses.en: in a way that shows no care or attention

example.en: He carelessly left the door unlocked.
example.zh: 他粗心大意，没锁门就走了。

senses.en: something that develops naturally as a result of something else

example.en: The new community center was an outgrowth of years of local volunteering.
example.zh: 新的社区中心是多年本地志愿活动的产物。

senses.en: a part that grows out from a plant or body

example.en: Small outgrowths appeared on the surface of the leaf.
example.zh: 叶片表面长出了细小的突起。

senses.en: a harsh sound made by rubbing one thing against another

example.en: He heard the scraping of chairs on the floor upstairs.
example.zh: 他听到楼上椅子在地板上刮擦的声音。

senses.en: small pieces of material scraped off a surface, usually in plural

example.en: The recipe calls for scrapings of vanilla from the pod.
example.zh: 这个食谱需要从香草荚中刮下的碎屑。

senses.en: to make something legally or officially invalid

example.en: The court nullified the contract because it was unfair.
example.zh: 法院因合同不公而宣布其无效。

senses.en: to cancel out or counteract an effect

example.en: The new rules could nullify the benefits of the plan.
example.zh: 新规则可能抵消该计划的好处。

senses.en: acts of hitting something or someone; blows or collisions

example.en: The boxer took several hard hits before falling.
example.zh: 那名拳击手挨了几记重击后倒下了。

senses.en: visits or clicks recorded on a website; very popular songs or works

example.en: The website got thousands of hits after the news broke.
example.zh: 消息传出后，该网站的点击量达到数千次。
